title: 🛒 Multiple Customer Service & Retail Jobs in Ventura County - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Ventura County’s retail and service scene is buzzing this month, with several employers hiring for friendly, people-first roles. Whether you like helping customers face-to-face or keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes, there’s something here for you.
Service Writer – Auto Care Center Employer: Inside Car Guys
Location: Newbury Park, CA
Type: Full-time
Pay: $32.78–$39.47/hour
If you know your way around cars and enjoy helping customers understand their service needs, this could be a great fit. You’ll greet clients, schedule repairs, and keep them updated on progress—all while working with a trusted local auto team.
Sales Associate – Part-Time Employer: Calvin Klein
Location: Camarillo, CA
Type: Part-time
Pay: $16.90–$21.40/hour
Join an iconic fashion brand and bring your energy to the sales floor. This role offers flexible hours, generous discounts, and a chance to grow your retail skills in a stylish, team-focused setting.
Customer Service – Self Storage Manager Employer: Public Storage
Location: Simi Valley, CA
Type: Full-time
Pay: $19/hour + bonuses
If you like working independently and keeping things organized, this job offers steady hours, benefits, and performance bonuses. You’ll help customers find storage solutions and keep facilities in top shape.
Take a look and apply soon—these local spots are filling up fast!
Please note: Job listings change quickly. Some positions listed here may have already been filled, and links may no longer be active. Contact the employer or visit the official website directly for the most up-to-date information.
